title: Identify exclusively virtual charter schools in California that opened afte
question: Identify exclusively virtual charter schools in California that opened after 2005 and have an SAT excellence rate greater than 0.2. For these schools, return the school name, city, phone number, charter funding type, and the eligible free meal rate for students aged 5–17. Only include schools where both SAT and FRPM data are available.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
  s."XCL_050" AS city,
  s."XCL_058" AS phone_number,
  s."XCL_065" AS charter_funding_type,
  CAST(f."XCL_025" AS REAL) / f."XCL_024" AS eligible_free_meal_rate_5_17
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f
  ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN satscores AS t
  ON s."XCL_041" = t."XCL_030"
WHERE s."XCL_052" = 'CA'
  AND s."XCL_063" = 1
  AND s."XCL_076" = 'F'
  AND s."XCL_061" > '2005-12-31'
  AND CAST(t."XCL_040" AS REAL) / t."XCL_036" > 0.2
  AND f."XCL_024" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."XCL_025" IS NOT NULL
  AND t."XCL_036" IS NOT NULL
  AND t."XCL_040" IS NOT NULL
